scope: Coordinator source-informed fresh wordings frozen before first retrieval. Source and some existing answers already seen; not blind. Become development regressions after use.

cases.question: What did Johnny throw away rather than clean?
cases.expected: A mud-filled Shadowgate copy from early collecting. Disposal, not a sale or return; rough two-dollar recollection is not current value.

cases.question: Were the three crushed Game Boy games kept?
cases.expected: All three unnamed games went back. No title identification or retained ownership.

cases.question: Did Kat already love the choice-based game Johnny recommended?
cases.expected: Only about fifteen minutes into Life is Strange, she neither loved nor hated it and planned a fair try. Minecraft had not been played.

cases.question: Did the parcel include the preamp Tyler paid for?
cases.expected: No. Tyler says the seller omitted the actual $149.99 preamp. Payment is not receipt.

cases.question: Whose game had a registration card despite the Reddit seller's play plans?
cases.expected: Tyler bought Mega Turrican and reports recognizing the Reddit finder as the seller; the seller's intent cannot be independently established.

cases.question: Why were PAL labels not enough to settle cartridge region?
cases.expected: Johnny gives a US-set preference based on European packaging; neither host settles software/cartridge region encoding. I Am Setsuna inspection is only proposed.

cases.question: Why did a separately packed mug delay Johnny's games?
cases.expected: Johnny reports approximately sixteen months waiting for Cotton-related games because of a generic special-edition mug; he says it was packed separately and wanted ready games shipped sooner. Historical account, not verified vendor causation.

cases.question: Was Tyler sure the jewel-case Chex Quest was wrong for his cereal box?
cases.expected: No. Seeing a disc/manual shrink-wrapped inside another box prompted him to get that version, but they allow both might have been distributed. Exact exclusivity remains uncertain.

cases.question: Why buy a PS2 Zatch Bell copy for a GameCube collection?
cases.expected: Johnny wanted its card for his GameCube game; purchase is reported, completed transfer is not.

cases.question: Did the hosts confirm the water bottle belonged to Resident Evil 4?
cases.expected: No. A listener raises it, but the bottle they find appears related to Outbreak. They request further information and do not establish RE4 special-edition inclusion.

cases.question: Was Sonic chosen as one specific game or something broader?
cases.expected: They settle on Sonic as a franchise/concept after failing to agree on one installment. It must not become an individual-game choice.

cases.question: Did that great 1982 arcade year actually yield a retained game?
cases.expected: No. Despite considering Galaga, Pitfall and ET among many candidates, they conclude none for1982; importance and affection do not automatically mean retention.
